notes: The USCIS forms Zuzu can onboard on demand. `pdf` is the official fillable PDF; `page` is the instructions page rtrvr reads for the document checklist. Onboarding needs no code change -- POST /forms/onboard fetches the PDF, extracts its AcroForm inventory, derives a schema, and registers it.

forms.title: Application for Naturalization
forms.why: Becoming a U.S. citizen. One of the highest-volume USCIS forms.

forms.title: Petition for Alien Relative
forms.why: Family-based immigration. The most filed USCIS petition.

forms.title: Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
forms.why: Green card from inside the U.S.

forms.title: Application for Travel Document
forms.why: Advance parole and re-entry permits. Often filed alongside I-765.

forms.title: Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card
forms.why: Renewing or replacing a green card.

forms.title: Petition to Remove Conditions on Residence
forms.why: Conditional residents moving to a permanent green card.

forms.title: Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA
forms.why: Financial sponsorship, required with most family green cards.

forms.title: Consideration of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals
forms.why: DACA requests, filed together with I-765.

forms.title: Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal
forms.why: Asylum. High stakes and high volume.

forms.title: Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative
forms.why: Filed whenever a representative is involved.

forms.title: Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status
forms.why: Status extensions and changes for nonimmigrants.
